**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

The agreement contains no MFN mechanic burdening Clear Capital. Compensation is fixed exclusively by each Statement of Work (§ 3(a)–(b)), and targeted searches for most-favoured-nation, "no less favorable", best-price, price-matching, benchmarking and comparable-customer language returned nothing across §§ 1–7. Accordingly, we are not obliged to extend RadialSpark any terms given to third parties or to match third-party offers — the preferred position ("no MFN obligation on Customer") is satisfied and no redline is warranted.

One rationale-level note only: § 3(b) lets Contractor change rates on 30 days' notice. That is a pricing-flexibility issue for the pricing rule, not an MFN obligation, so it is not flagged here.
